messages:
Rae (Design): quick sync on the compact metrics pill idea. goal: a thin bar above the main heatmap that shows p95 + rps + error rate in a single-line pill to save vertical space. mock here: https://img.redwood.dev/compact-pill.png

Jon (Frontend): visually neat. how does it behave when there are many routes? does each row get its own pill or is it global?

Priya (PM): product wants per-route pills when drilling into a route list. for overview page we'll keep one global pill with a selector for route groups. main ask: make p95 obvious.

Luis (Eng-Infra): performance note: per-row pills with live sparklines could add a lot of load on the client. propose server-side micro-tiles or a single shared canvas for sparklines.

Zoe (a11y): accessibility first: pill must be reachable by keyboard, have a clear focus state, and the tiny sparkline SVGs need descriptive aria-labels. contrast on the error-rate chip is low in current mock.

Rae (Design): good catch on contrast. i tried a muted red for error; will increase saturation. also thinking of a visual hierarchy: p95 larger, p50 smaller, rps subtle.

Jon (Frontend): ordering idea: show p95 value then a tiny chevron to expand the pill into full legend. expansion should be animated but prefers reduced-motion respect.

Priya (PM): copy debate: what to label the collapsed pill? options: "Metrics", "Latencies", or explicit values like "p95 230ms". My vote: explicit value helps scannability.

Zoe (a11y): if we show live values as label, ensure aria-live polite region announces meaningful changes and rate-limit announcements. avoid constant chatter.

Luis (Eng-Infra): backend needs to support sampled vs unsampled series. default to sampled for UI responsiveness. raw fetch on expand with a throttled debounce.

Rae (Design): suggestion: default collapsed label = "p95 230ms" (example) and a small icon for sampling mode. tooltip on hover explains sampling.

Jon (Frontend): sampling control: two states auto / raw. we can implement as a toggle button with aria-pressed. keyboard shortcut + tooltip recommended. also add data attribute to help CSS selectors.

Zoe (a11y): label for toggle should be "Sampling: automatic" or "Sampling: raw" and toggles should announce new state via aria-live. also include a longdesc link or help panel explaining tradeoffs.

Priya (PM): copy for the sampling tooltip draft: "Automatic sampling smooths spikes to reduce noise and improve performance. View raw data for precise points (may increase load)." thoughts?

Rae (Design): trim to: "Auto-sample: smooths noisy data to keep the UI responsive. Toggle to fetch raw points (higher cost)." We'll put the longer explanation in the help panel.

Jon (Frontend): implementation nuance: toggling raw will fire requests across visible routes; add a confirmation modal for large time windows or many routes. backend should return a warning if cost estimate > threshold.

Luis (Eng-Infra): will add a cost-estimate endpoint. also suggest a per-account quota for raw fetches and signal via UI when approaching limit.

Zoe (a11y): mobile/tap targets: ensure the pill and each mini-chip have >= 48px touch target. current compact mock is too tight. also ensure color-only meaning (like red for errors) has an icon or label too.

Rae (Design): noted. i'll increase padding on mobile and add a small error icon inside the chip. we'll test contrast and touch targets in the next mock.

Priya (PM): QA acceptance criteria proposal: 1) p95 is top-priority visually; 2) collapsed pill shows latest p95 value; 3) sampling toggle defaults to auto and fetches raw on user action with confirmation for large queries; 4) keyboard accessible and aria announcements are in place.

Jon (Frontend): dev tasks: compact CSS, collapse/expand animation, aria-live region, sampling toggle wiring, shortcut 'm' to focus pill, analytics events for toggles. estimate 3-4 sprints with infra changes.

Luis (Eng-Infra): infra tasks: cost-estimate endpoint, server-side microtiles for sparklines, quota checks, feature flags for raw fetch. I'll scope out effort.

Zoe (a11y): i'll create an a11y checklist and run a quick keyboard-only prototype test once you have the branch. checklist will include focus order, aria-pressed, aria-live throttling, color contrast, and touch target sizes.

Rae (Design): great. i'll upload an updated mock with wider pills, stronger error color, and the new copy. will also add a Loom showing keyboard + sampling flow.

ci-bot: Build queued for branch/compact-pill-proto  build#4892 started.

Priya (PM): thanks team. next step: Rae posts updated assets, Jon links PR, Luis posts infra plan. we'll schedule a quick review next Wed.
